title: cert: chain walk can loop on certificate cycle in bag
description: In cert.rs validate_chain(), with a crafted bag containing a certificate cycle (A issues B, B issues A, both with valid signatures), the loop walks A->B->A->B... consuming all 10 depth slots and returns CertChain('chain too long') instead of CertChain('cycle detected'). This is not a security bypass (the chain is rejected), but the error message is misleading and the 10-step limit is silently consumed. No DoS risk since MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=10 is a hard cap. Low severity: cosmetic/diagnostic quality issue only.
